processing: Original PNGs copied unchanged. Shader uses mirrored sampling to close edges; Godot imports use VRAM compression and mipmaps. Night and twilight are shader color treatments, not separately authored panoramas.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game sky texture, seamless equirectangular 360 degree panorama, 2:1 aspect ratio 2048x1024. Create a restrained late-1990s Dreamcast rally sky: blue muted zenith blending to pale blue gray horizon at image midheight, broad soft distant cloud banks only near horizon, mostly open sky above for a separate animated cloud layer. Lower hemisphere plain muted blue gray, no terrain. Painterly clean large shapes, no fine grain, no photographic HDR, no dramatic lighting. No sun, moon, stars, mountains, ground, buildings, text or watermark. Left and right edges must join perfectly; zenith top edge uniform color for spherical mapping. Horizon horizontal at exactly middle. Full image is the texture, no frames or presentation.
